name: Adaptive Particle System Surface Extraction
aliases: Adaptive surface sampling algorithm based on a particle system
definition: An adaptive surface sampling algorithm that uses a particle system to extract surfaces from industrial CT data, decoupling force mechanisms and using adaptive weighted projection to drive particles to precise edges.
summary: Adaptive Particle System Surface Extraction generates high-quality surface point clouds from CT data using physics-based particle optimization to adapt sampling density to local curvature, reducing vertex count while improving distribution uniformity.
